concerns.text: Task T004d (Implement validators) is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but explicitly depends on T004c (Generate schema files). Parallel-safe tasks cannot have hard dependencies on other tasks within the same phase that produce their input artifacts. T004d must be sequential to T004c, or the [P] tag must be removed.

Task T013 (Implement parser) is marked [P] but explicitly states 'requires verified data from T016'. T016 (Checksum verification) is a prerequisite for T013. A task consuming an artifact (verified data) cannot be parallel-safe with the task producing that artifact. The [P] tag on T013 is incorrect.

Task T026 (Sensitivity analysis) is marked [P] but explicitly depends on T025 (Generate fit_summary.csv). T035 (Generate summary) depends on T026. These form a strict serial chain (T025 -> T026 -> T035). Marking T026 as [P] implies it can run in parallel with its producer (T025) or other independent tasks, which violates the data-flow dependency.

Task T036 (Generate verdict) is marked [P] but depends on T034 (Generate residual_stats.csv). T034 depends on T031, T032, T033. This is a serial dependency chain. The [P] tag on T036 is invalid as it cannot execute before T034 completes.

Phase 6 (Computational Mechanism) is listed as 'Priority: P4' but the 'Notes' section states 'Phase 6... removed as it was unanchored scope creep' while simultaneously adding it back in 'Revision Action'. This creates a semantic contradiction in the plan's intent, though the internal task dependencies (T044->T045->T046...) appear consistent within the phase.
